Subject: Discovery recap: HealthCorp Private VPC & KMS requirements

Hi Sana / Jordan -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we discussed and proposed next steps so we're all aligned. If I missed anything please flag it and we'll update.

Pain points / drivers
- Regulated PHI workloads: strict data residency and audit requirements for inference and logging.
- Customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) required for encryption at rest and in-transit key handling.
- Network constraints: want Private VPC deployment with no egress for certain namespaces, and support for site-to-site VPN / dedicated interconnect.
- Air-gap / on-prem considerations for future proofing some environments (legal/controlled environments).

Current stack (what you told us)
- Inference currently on a mix of on-prem GPU clusters + managed cloud for batch workloads.
- Primary identity/crypto is Azure Key Vault, with plans to evaluate HSM-backed keys.
- Auth/NAT flows: traffic currently goes through an internal transit gateway; security team prefers inbound-only control for managed services.

Success criteria for POC / pilot
- Private (VPC-isolated) deployment of Redwood control plane with inference nodes in HealthCorp VPCs or dedicated colocation.
- Redwood integrates with HealthCorp-managed KMS/HSM for model keys and audit logs.
- No persistent egress for protected namespaces; explicit allowlist for telemetry.
- End-to-end latency under 120ms p50 for typical clinical inference payloads.
- SOC2 / ISO artifacts and penetration test summary provided to security.

Risks & open questions
- Network topology: need a network diagram showing transit gateway and firewall rules (Jordan, can you share the latest?).
- HSM integration pattern: whether we need an HSM sidecar vs. Redwood calling HealthCorp KMS endpoints.
- Procurement timeline / PO: any constraints for provisioning Dedicated capacity?

Next steps and owners
- HealthCorp: share network diagram and a list of required IP ranges for peering (Jordan) - expected by end of week.
- Redwood: share SOC2 summary and a short runbook for KMS/HSM integration (Aditya) - by Thu 12 Feb.
- Redwood: schedule technical deep-dive with infra/security engineers (Vivek) - propose slots Fri 13 Feb or Mon 16 Feb.
- Both: sign NDA / addendum if required for on-prem discussions (we can circulate standard doc).

Attachments: I've attached a brief SOC2 summary and a simple requirements checklist.

Thanks - looking forward to the next call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
